resources.string: Choosing a provider enables automatic hash lookups when scanning is on. VirusDetec also receives APK metadata. Tapping Scan can upload the complete APK to the selected provider; do not upload private or confidential files. Providers are separate services; no automatic fallback is used.
Choose a provider to enable scanning. No scan requests are sent until you choose.
VirusTotal: direct access with your personal API key. Uploaded files may be shared with security partners. This client supports uploads up to 32 MiB. Public API quotas apply.
VirusDetec: a separate service at virusdetect.pwhs.app, with a workers.dev fallback. Uses a built-in client key, not your VirusTotal key. Its findings are not VirusTotal engine results.
Use the selected provider for automatic hash lookups
Install remains the main action. Review scan details or start a scan when you choose.
Prioritize scanning and ask for confirmation before installing without a verdict. VirusTotal requires your API key; VirusDetec does not.
